Several [[Rabbit (white)|white rabbits]] are encountered in the [[Far Shiverpeaks]] and [[Charr Homelands]]. They will flee when someone approaches them.

Those in the [[rabbit hole]] will become hostile when approached and will be surrounded by [[Vaettir]]. The rabbit here is actually [[Nulfastu Earthbound]] luring victims to their doom, as stated by [[Notorious Foe: Nulfastu, Earthbound]].

==Locations==
*[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Drakkar Lake}} (at the [[rabbit hole]])
*[[Charr Homelands]]
**{{NPC location|Grothmar Wardowns}}

==Notes==
*A rabbit in Drakkar Lake will run down a circular ramp when approached; this is a trap to lure players into an ambush by [[Nulfastu Earthbound]] and 59 [[Vaettir]].
*The rabbit in [[Grothmar Wardowns]] is spotted near the [[Resurrection Shrine]] next to [[Longeye's Ledge]] and will run up. This rabbit will also run away once approached; however, this rabbit will only lead to [[Vael]].

==Trivia==
*In ''[[w:Alice's Adventures in Wonderland|Alice's Adventures in Wonderland]]'', Alice follows a white rabbit into a tunnel leading her to Wonderland.
*In ''[[w:Monty Python and the Holy Grail|Monty Python and the Holy Grail]]'' there is a white rabbit which is believed by the protagonists to be harmless but turns out to be a [[w:Rabbit of Caerbannog|deadly monster]].
**White rabbits have red eyes and long fangs (observed during the death animation), similar to the Rabbit of Caerbannog and [[W:Bunnicula|Bunnicula]].
*There is a 1% chance that when you travel down into the rabbit hole 59 level 5 (23 in Hard Mode) enemy rabbits with no skills will spawn as opposed to the Vaettir, although the boss Vaettir will still spawn.
